jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sample Systems is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. Our platform team keeps the lights on for every product team.

What you will do

  • Run our Kubernetes clusters on AWS
  • Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Improve deploys, alerts and on-call

What we look for

  • 2+ years of experience operating production systems
  • Hands-on Kubernetes, AWS and Terraform

This is a hybrid role with three days a week in our Springfield office.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sample Systems is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. Our analytics team turns sales and support data into weekly reports for the leadership team.

  • 2+ years of experience with SQL and dashboards
  • Comfort presenting numbers to people who are not analysts
  • Spreadsheet skills that make finance people smile

Remote within Canada.
